f.title: Include the black triangle and standard explanatory statement in SmPC and PL
f.statement: The MAH shall include in the SmPC and package leaflet of its medicinal products subject to additional monitoring the black triangle symbol and the standardised explanatory statement on additional monitoring.
f.applicability: Medicinal products included in the additional monitoring list: mandatory scope under REG Art 23(1) (new active substances not authorised in the EU on 1 January 2011; other biologicals authorised after 1 January 2011; products with a PASS imposed at or after authorisation; products with specific obligations on recording or reporting of suspected adverse reactions beyond Chapter 3 of the Directive; conditional marketing authorisations; authorisations under exceptional circumstances) and products added under the optional scope of REG Art 23(2)

rows.quote: shall include in the SmPC and Package leaflet of their medicinal products subject to additional monitoring the black triangle symbol and the and the standardised explanatory statement on additional monitoring;
rows.review_note: Review: Applicability expanded with the mandatory-scope categories from X.C.1.1 (former rows 0001-0002, which stated an Agency listing duty, were dropped and folded in here). Lifecycle, level and classification confirmed. Double-check: Mandatory (shall) and MAH actor confirmed, but the quote is a list item without its lead-in 'The marketing authorisation holder:' (actor taken from the heading) and the source has a duplicated 'and the and the'. Currency: EMA GVP page (checked 2026-11-10) lists Module X EMA/169546/2012 with no revision label, effective 25/04/2013, matching this text; no Rev 1 found. No duplicate committed curation.

f.title: State additional monitoring status in HCP and patient materials and encourage ADR reporting
f.statement: The MAH should include information on the additional monitoring status in any material to be distributed to healthcare professionals and patients and should make all efforts to encourage reporting of adverse reactions, as agreed with national competent authorities.
f.applicability: Medicinal products subject to additional monitoring

rows.quote: should include information on the status of additional monitoring in any material to be distributed to healthcare professionals and patients and should make all efforts to encourage reporting of adverse reactions, as agreed with national competent authorities;
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Level Recommended (should) correct; quote is a list item missing its lead-in 'The marketing authorisation holder:' so actor comes from the heading. Version confirmed current on EMA GVP page.

f.title: Provide evidence on the status of imposed conditions
f.statement: The MAH should provide evidence to the competent authorities concerned on the status of any conditions imposed by the national competent authorities or the European Commission.

rows.quote: should provide evidence to the competent authorities concerned on the status of any conditions imposed by the national competent authorities or the European Commission;
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Recommended (should) correct; quote lacks the lead-in naming the MAH (actor from heading). Version confirmed current.

f.title: Submit the variation to include or remove the black symbol and statements
f.statement: The MAH should submit the relevant variation to include or remove the black symbol, the statement and the standardised explanatory sentence from the SmPC and package leaflet, where applicable.

rows.quote: should submit the relevant variation to include/remove the black symbol, the statement, and the standardised explanatory sentence from the SmPC and PL, where applicable.
rows.review_note: Review: Kept separate from 0011 (0007 is the general MAH duty listed in X.C.3.5; 0011 covers decisions taken outside a regulatory procedure). No other change. Double-check: Recommended (should) correct; quote lacks the lead-in naming the MAH (actor from heading); 'PL' expanded to package leaflet. Version confirmed current.

f.title: SmPC statement preceded by an inverted black triangle for listed products
f.statement: For medicinal products included in the list, the SmPC shall include the statement "This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring. This will allow quick identification of new safety information. Healthcare professionals are asked to report any suspected adverse reactions. See section 4.8 for how to report adverse reactions.", preceded by an inverted equilateral black triangle (Implementing Regulation (EU) No 198/2013); a similar statement is included in the package leaflet.
f.clause: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
f.applicability: Medicinal products included in the additional monitoring list: mandatory scope under REG Art 23(1) (new active substances not authorised in the EU on 1 January 2011; other biologicals authorised after 1 January 2011; products with a PASS imposed at or after authorisation; products with specific obligations on recording or reporting of suspected adverse reactions beyond Chapter 3 of the Directive; conditional marketing authorisations; authorisations under exceptional circumstances) and products added under the optional scope of REG Art 23(2)

rows.quote: For medicinal products included in the list, the SmPC shall include the statement: “This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring. This will allow quick identification of new safety information. Healthcare professionals are asked to report any suspected adverse reactions. See section 4.8 for how to report adverse reactions.”, preceded by an inverted equilateral black triangle (Implementing Regulation (EU) No 198/2013). A similar statement will also be included in the package leaflet.
rows.location: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
rows.review_note: Review: Applicability expanded with the mandatory/optional scope. Actor kept as MAH (labelling owner); level Mandatory (shall, Implementing Regulation 198/2013). Double-check: Mandatory (shall, IR 198/2013) correct, but the shall attaches to the SmPC, not a named actor; MAH inferred as labelling owner. Version confirmed current.

f.title: Update SmPC and PL when the product is included in or removed from the list
f.statement: Once the medicinal product is included in or removed from the list, the MAH shall update the SmPC and the package leaflet to include or remove, as appropriate, the black symbol, the statement and the standardised explanatory statement.
f.clause: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
f.applicability: Products entering or leaving the additional monitoring list. For new active substances and biologicals approved after 1 January 2011 the initial inclusion period is five years after the Union Reference Date (DIR Art 107c(5)); for optional-scope products the period is set by the European Commission or national competent authority and linked to fulfilment of the conditions.

rows.deadline: When the product is included in or removed from the list
rows.quote: Once the medicinal product is included or removed from the list, the marketing authorisation holder shall update the SmPC and the package leaflet to include or remove, as appropriate, the black symbol, the statement, and the standardised explanatory statement.
rows.location: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
rows.review_note: Review: Applicability now records the initial five-year inclusion period after the Union Reference Date for new active substances and post-2011 biologicals (X.C.2.1; former Agency-actor row 0003 dropped and folded in here) and that optional-scope periods are linked to fulfilment of the conditions (X.C.2.2). Double-check: Quote names MAH, shall and the full duty; applicability context (five-year period) drawn from X.C.2 but is scope only. Version confirmed current (EMA page lists EMA/169546/2012, effective 25/04/2013).

f.title: Update product information before finalisation when listing is decided within a procedure
f.statement: If the decision to include or remove a product from the list is taken during the assessment of a regulatory procedure (e.g. marketing authorisation application, extension of indication, renewal), the SmPC and package leaflet should be updated before finalisation of the procedure to include or remove the black triangle symbol and explanatory statement.
f.clause: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
f.applicability: Listing decisions taken during a regulatory procedure

rows.deadline: Before finalisation of the regulatory procedure
rows.quote: If the decision to include or remove a medicinal product from the list is done during the assessment of a regulatory procedure (e.g. marketing authorisation application, extension of indication, renewal) the SmPC and the package leaflet should be updated before finalisation of the procedure in order to include or remove the black triangle symbol and explanatory statement from the product information.
rows.location: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: Recommended (should) correct; passive voice, MAH actor inferred. Version confirmed current.

f.title: Submit a variation when listing is decided outside a regulatory procedure
f.statement: If the decision to include or remove a product from the list is taken outside a regulatory procedure, the MAH is requested to subsequently submit a variation to update the product information accordingly.
f.clause: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
f.applicability: Listing decisions taken outside a regulatory procedure

rows.quote: If the decision to include or remove a medicinal product from the list is done outside a regulatory procedure, then the marketing authorisation holder is requested to subsequently submit a variation to update the product information of that product accordingly.
rows.location: X.C.5. Black symbol and explanatory statements
rows.review_note: Review: Overlaps 0007 but adds the trigger (decision taken outside a regulatory procedure); kept. Double-check: 'is requested to' read as Recommended - judgement call on level. Version confirmed current.

dates.title: GVP Module X (additional monitoring): comes into effect
dates.scope: GVP Module X (additional monitoring): marketing authorisation holders, competent authorities in Member States and the Agency
dates.quote: Date for coming into effect 25 April 2013
dates.timing_note: Cover-page 'Date for coming into effect'. 19 April 2013 is the adoption date.
